title: A merge conflict with the group or a cases_wrong revision does not use up a round
objective: The issuer stops a ticket for rounds only after devloop.max_rounds rounds that were not free (free = the round ended on a merge conflict with the target or on a revision that threw out the verifier's cases) or after 2 x devloop.max_rounds rounds in all, and the stuck page says how many rounds were real reds and how many were free.
outline: devloop/ticket_issuer.py: (1) go(): the 'round start' save writes event(x, 'round start', round=<new round>); the while condition becomes the two limits of acceptance 6, computed from free_rounds(t) on the ticket read at the top of each pass; the Stuck('rounds', ...) text gets the tally of acceptance 7, inserted before '; last feedback:' (the board's ticket_category still finds 'merging the latest ... failed (' and 'no machine slot came free' in the text and the last feedback). (2) _round()/integrate(): remember which exit was free (for example self._free = 'merge' where integrate's merge of the target fails, 'revision' where THROWN_OUT is returned, cleared at each round start); _fed_back writes event(t, 'feedback', round=r, free=<kind>) only for a free round. (3) New module-level free_rounds(t). Docs: the module docstring ('Per round (at most devloop.max_rounds ...') and devloop/README.md line 14 ('failing step = feedback for the next round (max 3 rounds, 3 hours)') say that a merge conflict with the group or a revision that threw out the cases does not count, at most 2 x max_rounds rounds in all. Do not edit devloop/README.md line 48 (the settings list) and do not edit docs/DECISIONS.md (hard_block; the main session records the rule change). No merge agent: the next round's worker resolves the conflict as today.
test_plan: Verifier: one new class T<id>Acceptance in tests_devloop/test_devloop.py placed directly after class RoundsAndFeedback (before class T62Acceptance), not at the end of the file. Cases: (a) acceptance 5 as unit cases on hand-built tickets; assert hasattr(ticket_issuer, 'free_rounds') first so the case fails by assertion before the change. With rs(n) = {'event': 'round start', 'round': n} and fb(n, free) = {'event': 'feedback', 'round': n, 'free': free} (no 'free' key when free is None): {'round': 3, 'history': [rs(1), fb(1,'merge'), rs(2), fb(2,'revision'), rs(3), fb(3,None)]} -> {'merge': 1, 'revision': 1}; {'round': 1, 'history': [rs(1), fb(1,'merge'), rs(2), fb(2,'merge'), {'event': 'user decision: ready'}, rs(1), fb(1,'revision')]} -> {'merge': 0, 'revision': 1}; {'round': 0, 'history': [rs(1), fb(1,'merge'), rs(2), fb(2,'merge'), {'event': 'user decision: ready'}]} -> {'merge': 0, 'revision': 0}; {'round': 1, 'history': [{'event': 'round start'}, {'event': 'feedback', 'round': 1}]} -> {'merge': 0, 'revision': 0}; {} -> {'merge': 0, 'revision': 0}. (b) acceptance 8, 9 and 10 end to end with the LoopCase helpers (self.config(max_rounds=1), self.add, self.plan, self.controller(), self.snap(), self.inbox), each from its own fixture; in 8 find the stuck one of the two tickets by state (which one loses the merge race is not fixed) and the decision page by ref; the expected texts are the ones in this ticket. Strip every DEVLOOP_* variable from self.env in setUp. Implementer's own unit tests (placed directly after class ApplyUnapplied, before class T11Acceptance): acceptance 3 (the exits that are not free), 4, the hard-cap boundary of 6 and the text format of 7.
notes: Measured on main f50b578 with the loop harness: (a) max_rounds 1, tickets 1 and 2 both 'shared': #1 landed, #2 stuck at round 1 with 'merging the latest int/g1 into t/2 failed (CONFLICT (add/add): Merge conflict in shared.txt) - another ticket of this group changed the same files; merge int/g1 yourself and resolve'; (b) max_rounds 1, worker ['revise'], creator ['revised']: stuck at round 1; (c) the fixtures of acceptance 9 and 10: both stuck at round 1 with 'round 1: the ticket was revised during this round ...' as the last feedback. Why free is 'merge'/'revision' and not true: the stuck page splits the free rounds by kind. Why the count is anchored on the 'round start' event with round 1: the round goes back to 0 when a ticket is opened, on a user retry/revise (ticket_creator.user_reset) and on `tickets.py ready N` (tickets.py _set); an interrupted round is taken back (Issuer.release) so its next start has the same number; an issuer that died mid-round leaves the round counted without a feedback event (it counts as real). History keeps the last 50 events; an event that fell out only makes the free count lower. Existing case that keeps passing unchanged, by another path: T20Acceptance.test_3_a_revision_in_the_last_round_goes_stuck_not_merged (max_rounds 1, worker ['revise'] repeats) still ends stuck/rounds with 'threw out' in the last feedback, now after 2 free rounds instead of 1 (inferred; rerun it). Group fix-round tests with max_rounds 1 (worker 'red', fixer ...) are about auto_fixer and are not affected. Out of scope: auto_fixer's fix rounds; the verifier-branch merge failure stays a counted round; the board's DAG node text '第 r/max 輪' and the worker prompt 'round {round} of {max_rounds}' may show a round above max_rounds (the request keeps t.round counting every round).
acceptance: In a round that ends because merging the latest target into t/N failed in Issuer.integrate (the feedback 'merging the latest <target> into <branch> failed (...) - another ticket of this group changed the same files; merge <target> yourself and resolve'), the ticket's 'feedback' history event for that round carries free = "merge".
In a round that ends with the THROWN_OUT feedback (a cases_wrong revision during the round), the round's 'feedback' event carries free = "revision".

Every other feedback event has no 'free' key: a red of the verifier's cases (also 'after taking in <target>: ...'), a failed merge of the verifier's branch t/N-cases into t/N, '<target> kept moving while merging; try again', a review failure, a worker or verifier problem.
The 'round start' event the issuer writes carries round = the number of the round it starts (1, 2, ...).

ticket_issuer.free_rounds(t), a module-level function, returns {"merge": M, "revision": V}: the number of 'feedback' events in t['history'] whose free is 'merge' / 'revision', whose 'round' is <= t['round'] (missing round = 0), and that come after the last 'round start' event whose round is 1 (the whole history when no 'round start' event has round 1). A ticket without history or with round 0 gives {"merge": 0, "revision": 0}.

Before each round the issuer goes on only while t['round'] - (M + V) < devloop.max_rounds and t['round'] < 2 * devloop.max_rounds; otherwise the ticket is stuck with reason 'rounds'. t['round'] still counts every round (prompts, logs and the live record keep using it).

The 'rounds' stuck text is '<R> rounds used and still not passing (<R-M-V> real red, <M+V> free: <M> merge conflict, <V> revision); last feedback:\n<the last feedback entry>' with R = t['round'], and the decision page about the ticket is '#<id> is stuck (rounds): ' followed by that text (as today).

End to end, devloop.max_rounds 1, tickets 1 and 2 in one group whose workers both use the fake action 'shared' (each writes shared.txt with its own content): one lands; the other is stuck with reason 'rounds' at round 2, both of its 'feedback' events carry free 'merge', and its decision page text contains '2 rounds used and still not passing (0 real red, 2 free: 2 merge conflict, 0 revision)'.
End to end, devloop.max_rounds 1, ticket 1 with worker plan ['revise', 'ok'] and creator plan ['revised']: the ticket lands, its round is 2, and its round-1 'feedback' event carries free 'revision'.

End to end, devloop.max_rounds 1, ticket 1 with worker plan ['revise', 'wrong'] and creator plan ['revised']: the ticket is stuck with reason 'rounds' at round 2 and its decision page text contains '2 rounds used and still not passing (1 real red, 1 free: 0 merge conflict, 1 revision)'.

vision: VISION 已裁示原則「自動修補最多 3 輪,第 3 輪仍紅才交我」: only real reds count again. Metrics 每張票需要我介入幾次 (down) and 等我處理的事積了多少 (down): T measured #137, #282, #286, #287 stuck about 20 h each after rounds spent on merge conflicts or revisions; each was one avoidable page and intervention.
removes: the rule that a merge conflict with the group or a cases_wrong revision costs one of devloop.max_rounds
request:
# Rounds count only real reds; pages that reach the user; quota words; small board fixes

Reported by T (the tabby project) after weeks on devloop; the main session checked each against the code at f50b578 and asked a second model to judge the designs for simplicity. No new role, no new state; one optional config key (devloop.notify). Read docs/DECISIONS.md (do not edit it).

1. A round counts only when the code was red (T measured: #137, #282, #286, #287 stuck ~20 h; read here). Today a round that ends because merging the latest int/gN into t/N conflicts (ticket_issuer.integrate, the "merge it yourself" feedback) or because a cases_wrong revision threw out the verifier's cases (THROWN_OUT) costs one of max_rounds. Rule: those two exits mark their feedback event free (e.g. free=true on the event); the round loop counts rounds minus free rounds against max_rounds, with a hard cap of 2 x max_rounds rounds in total; t.round keeps counting every round (logs and prompts use it). A red after taking in the target (cases fail) still counts. The next round's worker resolves the conflict as today (no merge agent). The stuck page says how many of its rounds were real reds and how many were free (merge conflict / revision), counted from those events.

2. devloop.notify (optional string, default null): a shell command run from pool.report (one place) for each new decision, env or idle page, detached, output appended to <worktrees>/runs/notify.log, failure ignored, never blocking the caller; the page's kind, subject and first line in env vars (DEVLOOP_PAGE_KIND, DEVLOOP_PAGE_SUBJECT, DEVLOOP_PAGE_TEXT) and its file path in DEVLOOP_PAGE. Documented with a macOS notification example and a phone push example. actl doctor checks its type. Purpose: pages waited 11-20 h because no main session was open.

3. Quota words (measured here: _says_quota returns False for '429 ... usage_limit_reached' and 'rate_limit_error'). Normalise '_' to ' ' in the text before matching QUOTA_SIGNS, and use the same normalised text in _excerpt. Do not add '429' as a sign (logs hold many 429s). Test with those two strings.

4. Opener out of quota (T measured twice: the page said no valid tickets). The opener runs in the foreground of `actl new`, so it must not wait hours for a reset. When its run's cost row says out of quota, do not try a second attempt; the page and stdout say: out of quota, the excerpt and the reset time if readable, send the request again after it.

5. joinable(): a ticket with a landed dependency may join an open group only when main is an ancestor of the group's branch (one git call); otherwise it waits (follow_main leaves a branch without main when merging main conflicted). Test with a group whose main merge conflicted.

6. Board: the 知道了 (ack) action with text in the box is refused by act_problem with a line telling to use 照我的話改 / 帶著我的話重驗 instead (today the text is silently dropped).

7. Release-failed page: name the last 'devloop-stage:' step the release printed and the last ~15 lines of its log. Move the board's live_release_step / live_tail helpers to a shared core module used by the board, ticket_controller's release page and tickets.py release, instead of writing them twice. The page claims nothing about production; a project's release script prints that itself.
